name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No tropical cyclones in the Atlantic on 8 Nov; none expected to form over seven days, per the NHC
state: The National Hurricane Center reported no tropical cyclone activity in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf as of 08:00 on 8 Nov, and expected none to form over the following seven days (USA TODAY Network, citing NHC). The 2026 season has produced 10 named storms and one hurricane so far, and the signal was quiet as of 9 Nov. The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm currently threatens land. People in hurricane-prone areas can follow the National Hurricane Center and national emergency agencies until the season closes on 30 Nov.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active and none threatening land within 5 days (NHC outlook, 8 Nov): Normal criterion.
